values: Laco Invoice ERP master-data and voucher template
Version 1.0  |  Import ERP master data locally, then prepare voucher lines without calling ERP for every action.
Load company and branch scope before other master data.
Use UTF-8 CSV or this XLSX workbook. Do not rename headers or change the template version.
ERP item and product records used by voucher lines.
Use external ERP IDs as stable identifiers. Codes and names can change; IDs must not.
ERP supplier records for AP and payment vouchers.
Enter dates as YYYY-MM-DD, numeric amounts without thousands separators, and YES/NO for active fields.
Chart of accounts used for debit and credit entries.
Review validation errors before importing. Never delete master records already referenced by vouchers; set active to NO instead.
Departments and cost centres used for allocation.
For Voucher_Lines, debit must equal credit for each local voucher number before ERP import or posting.
VAT and withholding tax codes and rates.
ISO currency codes and decimal rules.
Approved mappings from Laco transactions to ERP accounts.
Template fields follow docs/ERP_INTEGRATION_PLAN.md. Remove blank rows only if your ERP import tool requires a compact file.
